name: LP333 ID7 complete static symmetry transfer
hypothesis: The unchanged complete prefix-encoded lex leaders for the exact decimation-by-sequence-swap group can produce terminal SAT or proof-certified UNSAT evidence for fixed multiplier family ID7 under the existing caps.
evidence_unit: one exact source-pinned LP333 fixed multiplier family, ID7
claim_boundary: A promoted result decides only fixed ID7 and, through the separately established affine normalization, its coherent translated versions. It does not decide any other fixed family, unrestricted LP333, or H668.

baseline.evidence: Code commit 35f981e2e0980bb0302dfcfa1eb1ee5efef2546b; ID7 source orbit signature 3x1 plus 54x2 plus 2x3 plus 36x6; ID9 and ID10 terminal proofs under the same 72-action static mechanism.
baseline.measurement: ID7 is unresolved. The source model has 95 orbits per sequence; no complete ID7 proof or directly verified LP333 witness exists.

intervention.one_change: Transfer the frozen complete static decimation-and-sequence-swap lex-leader mechanism from the 59-orbit ID9 and ID10 families to the 95-orbit ID7 family.

controls.name: source-and-formula-binding
controls.purpose: Bind ID7, the proof encoder, the serialized CNF, the generator, and the exact source family records.
controls.expected: Every recorded SHA-256 matches immediately before the solver run.

controls.name: semantic-equivalence
controls.purpose: Detect a mismatch between direct length-333 arithmetic and the base CNF semantics.
controls.expected: All 1000 deterministic random orbit assignments agree, including all representative PAF and row-sum outputs.

controls.name: exact-group-control
controls.purpose: Prove every static lex leader comes from a legal finite formula automorphism.
controls.expected: The full 72-action group is closed and every orbit size, PAF diagonal, and PAF coefficient is preserved.

controls.name: positive-fixture
controls.purpose: Detect a bad decimation, sequence-swap, or lex orientation.
controls.expected: The published LP63 pair remains directly valid and has a lex-minimal representative under all decimation-and-swap actions.

controls.name: adversarial-proof-control
controls.purpose: Detect a proof checker that accepts false terminal evidence.
controls.expected: Pinned drat-trim rejects an empty proof against the known SAT control before and after any decisive UNSAT replay.

terminal_outcomes.promote: Either a complete SAT model passes the serialized CNF and direct 332-shift LP333 audit, or a complete UNSAT proof is accepted twice by pinned drat-trim with fresh bogus-proof rejection.
terminal_outcomes.park: All controls pass but the unchanged mechanism returns a valid nonterminal solver result without exhausting a declared resource, so this static transfer is archived without tuning.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: The wall, memory, proof-volume, or verification ceiling is reached, or an artifact is incomplete.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any source binding, semantic comparison, group invariant, positive fixture, model audit, proof replay, or bogus-proof control fails.

stop_rules: Stop before solving on any failed source, semantic, group, positive-fixture, or tool binding control.
Terminate the target process at 300 solver seconds, 4 GiB observed RSS, or 1 GiB proof bytes.
Do not interpret or replay an incomplete proof.
Do not change the seed, group, lex order, solver, or decomposition after observing ID7.

next_actions.promote: If UNSAT, archive ID7 and preregister a matched ID4 versus ID5 comparison. If SAT, independently verify the LP333 pair, construct H668, assemble the full candidate packet, and invoke the FrontierMath candidate verifier.
next_actions.park: Archive the valid nonterminal run and select a structurally different exact direction from the campaign ledger.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve strict UNKNOWN and run workload characterization on proof growth, clause activity, and the dominant solver resource before selecting one structural pivot.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest failed control, regenerate from a fresh output directory, and repeat Gate A before any target run.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts and source-pinned repositories are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by the exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms required by the campaign skill.
